question.problem:
What is the polar equation of the curve shown below?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14225098/assets/0ad44bfa452da482fff5f579f1be9569670f7ad8da347314bcb63f618eaf3d2a.png)
question.worked_solution:
The diagram shows a circle of radius $|a| = |-4.5|=4.5$ centered at the point $(0,-4.5).$ 

In polar coordinates, the equation of such a circle is given by 

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =2a\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta  \\  & =2\cdot (-4.5)\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta  \\  & =-9\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta .\end{aligned}
$$
